sentiment.rationale: Salesforce delivered a record quarter with strong results and raised its FY30 revenue target from $60B to $63B, indicating increased confidence in long-term growth. However, FY27 revenue guidance of 10-11% growth is roughly in line with FY26's 10% growth, and management explicitly cited continued weakness in marketing, commerce, and Tableau as offsets. The guidance raise is partly attributed to the Informatica acquisition, not purely organic, so the score is positive but not at the highest level.

summary.revenue: Q4 FY26 revenue of $11.2 billion, up 12% Y/Y (10% CC); FY26 revenue of $41.5 billion, up 10% Y/Y (9% CC).
summary.eps: Q4 FY26 GAAP diluted EPS of $2.07; FY26 GAAP diluted EPS of $7.80. Non-GAAP diluted EPS of $3.81 for Q4 and $12.52 for FY26.
summary.guidance: FY27 revenue guidance of $45.8-$46.2 billion, up 10-11% Y/Y; Q1 FY27 revenue of $11.03-$11.08 billion; FY27 non-GAAP operating margin of 34.3%; FY27 operating cash flow growth of approximately 9-10% Y/Y; FY30 revenue target raised to $63 billion.
summary.margin: FY26 GAAP operating margin of 20.1% and non-GAAP operating margin of 34.1%; Q4 GAAP operating margin of 16.7% and non-GAAP of 34.2%; FY27 guidance of 20.9% GAAP and 34.3% non-GAAP.
